svg.title: Highlights
svg.desc: AI platform: End to end. AI agent platform, in production. Automates the development cycle: analysis, code, testing and documentation. Legacy migration: 40+ modules. PHP core → NestJS + Prisma. A CodeIgniter monolith rebuilt in TypeScript with AI-assisted flows, zero downtime. CI/CD: Days → hours. Deploy time, cut down. Release automation on AWS and CircleCI. Cloud tooling: CLI → AWS. Whole environments, one tool. CLI tools that deploy complete environments on AWS. Payments: Automated. Billing and subscriptions. Stripe integration that runs billing and subscriptions on its own.

g.text: Results that made it to production
